root.label: UK contactless airport e-gates rollout begins

events.label: UK contactless airport e-gates rollout begins

slots.name: first airport deployed
slots.sentence: On Tuesday, East Midlands Airport became the first airport to offer the new technology

slots.name: speed increase
slots.sentence: Testing showed the new contactless system was up to 25% faster than using a passport, according to officials.

slots.name: minimum age requirement
slots.sentence: Our digital transformation also builds on our work this summer to extend eGates to children aged eight and above, making life a little easier for families.

slots.name: number of airports available
slots.sentence: Standard e-gates are currently available at Birmingham, Bristol, Cardiff, East Midlands, Edinburgh, Gatwick, Glasgow, Heathrow, London City, Luton, Manchester, Newcastle and Stansted.
